usedFor: flowyteam tracks key results and Google Docs holds the report, so “New Off-Track Key Result” adds text to a tab.

bestTemplate.name: “New Off-Track Key Result” in flowyteam, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A key result going off track lands in a document your team reviews, so slips get seen.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's content, so set it to add when logging results.
